data.name: Lotty
data.gender_notes: Lotty is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Lotty is derived from the Old English word 'lot', meaning 'fate' or 'destiny'. In its modern usage, Lotty is a diminutive form of the name Charlotte, which means 'free man' or 'man of the land' in Old French. Lotty is often given to girls and signifies a small, delicate, and endearing individual. The name Lotty carries the meaning “Little one” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Lotty usually hope their child will grow to embody little one and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Lotty belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Little one.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Lotty total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

in_latin.name: Lotia
in_latin.long_meaning: A Latin name derived from the word 'lactis' meaning 'milk'. It is not found in the Bible, but the root is present in several biblical names such as Lactantius, a Latin philosopher and early Christian apologist.

in_english.name: Lotty
in_english.long_meaning: A diminutive form of the English words 'lot' or 'lady'. It is not found in the Bible, but the root is present in several biblical names such as Lot, Leah, and Lactantius.

data.cultural_impact: The name Lotty holds a soft and endearing charm in English-speaking cultures, as it is often used for girls who are petite and delicate. Lotty is a name that evokes feelings of sweetness and gentleness, reminiscent of the beloved flower Lotus. It is also a name associated with the fictional character Charlotte Lucinda Mason from the novel "Little Women" by Louisa May Alcott, adding an additional layer of cultural significance to the name.
data.spiritual_significance: Lotty as a Christian name holds a deeper spiritual significance, as it is derived from the Old English word 'lot', signifying 'fate' or 'destiny'. This concept of fate and destiny can be seen as a reminder that our lives are not random occurrences, but rather part of a greater plan guided by a higher power. In this sense, the name Lotty can be seen as a call to trust in God's guidance and to embrace the twists and turns of life with faith and courage. Additionally, as a diminutive form of Charlotte, Lotty can be seen as a symbol of the inherent dignity and worth of every individual, reminding us to value and cherish the unique gifts and talents that each person brings to the world.
